test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two persons A and B start a journey from the same point at the speeds of 3 km/h and 4 km/h respectively. If they move in the same direction, then what will be the distance between them after 6 h?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of A = 3 km/h

Speed of B = 4 km/h

Time = 6h

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Distance traveled by A = 3 × 6 = 18 km

Distance traveled by B = 4 × 6 = 24 km

According to the question, after 6 hours

Difference between them = 24 - 18 = 6 km

**∴ The distance between them after 6 h will be 6 km.**
